_comment: English. Must carry EXACTLY the same key set as fr.json: js/i18n.js reports any mismatch in the console. Never translate the second one as 'stage'.

about.title: Code that runs, not just code that compiles.
about.p1: Holder of a professional bachelor's degree in Application Development and Administration from Université Alioune Diop de Bambey (awarded in 2026), I cover the full software lifecycle: data modelling (Merise, SQL), development (Java/Spring Boot, PHP/Laravel), and server deployment (Linux, Windows Server).
about.p2: I taught myself Spring Boot and React, outside the syllabus: that is the stack I designed and shipped my final-year project on, a platform for tracking judicial case files. Learning a technology because a project calls for it is how I work.
about.p3: What sets me apart: I don't only develop. I install, configure and secure the environments my applications run on. That dev + ops dual role is my natural launchpad into DevOps: CI/CD, containerisation, infrastructure as code.
about.p4: Open to an internship or a first role on an ambitious technical team.

projects.title: Selected projects
projects.intro: Academic and personal work. The repositories are private: each project is shown in screenshots, and the code is available on request.
projects.judicial.title: Judicial case file tracking platform
projects.judicial.text: Final-year project for my bachelor's degree: an application for tracking and processing the case files of detained persons. Spring Boot domain API, React 18 front end in TypeScript, scanned documents held as objects on MinIO, and updates pushed live to caseworkers over STOMP WebSocket.
projects.judicial.impact: → Entire stack self-taught, from the PostgreSQL model through to real time
projects.judicial.gallery: Screenshots, Judicial case file tracking platform
projects.thies.title: Redesign of the City of Thiès website
projects.thies.text: Full migration of the municipal site to Joomla: analysis of the existing architecture, UI/UX redesign to make public services easier for citizens to reach, and integration of dynamic modules.
projects.thies.impact: → Complete redesign: architecture, UI/UX and admin modules
projects.thies.gallery: Screenshots, Redesign of the City of Thiès website
projects.tontine.title: Tontine & Library Management
projects.tontine.text: Full stack web application: interface design, MySQL database modelling and management, access control, and automated report generation.
projects.tontine.impact: → Reports generated automatically, zero manual data entry
projects.insertion.title: Graduate Employment Application
projects.insertion.text: Desktop application connecting new graduates with recruiters, with an interface designed for a non-technical audience.
projects.insertion.impact: → Complete JavaFX interface, built from scratch
projects.infra.title: Windows Server infrastructure
projects.infra.text: Deployment and hardening of a Windows Server environment: installation, role configuration (AD DS, DNS, DHCP), and system hardening.
projects.infra.impact: → My first real ops project: the foundation of my move into DevOps

projects.stock.impact: → A clean data model before a line of code: data first
